intent.verbatim: a green verify can still mean nothing if the checks are weak — flag a contract with no real check or no regression surface

contract.goal: The adequacy critic runs and passes a strong contract under --gate.

check.expect: exit 0: the adequacy critic runs over a real contract
exit 0: a strong contract passes the adequacy gate (no STRONG weakness)

contract.out-of-scope: Judging the subject of a contract; adequacy critiques the contract's shape.
contract.regression-surface: A weak/vacuous contract must still be flagged; --gate must block on STRONG.
